questions.question: Portrait (tall) photos — crop them to 4:5, or leave as shot?
questions.explain: A light trim of about 17% of the height.

questions.question: Landscape (wide) photos — how should they be cropped?
questions.explain: 4:5 makes them tall and keeps only about half the width (a heavy crop). 5:4 stays wide with a light trim. none leaves them as shot.

questions.question: Which look should jobs use by default?
questions.explain: The house style made during setup.

questions.question: Export size — full size, or a long edge in pixels (e.g. 2048)?
Export format — JPEG or TIFF?
questions.explain: JPEG at quality 90, sRGB, suits web and print proofs.

questions.question: Where should finished photos go — the job's export folder, or somewhere else?
questions.explain: null means each job's own export folder.

questions.question: Bring LightCraft to the front when editing finishes?
questions.explain: So you can start reviewing straight away.
